title: AtomEngine dialogue
description: A conversation: nodes of one line each; a node with choices waits for one, a node without continues to "next"; "end" (or no next) closes it. Flags gate choices and record outcomes. The C++ parser (Game/Dialogue/Dialogue.cpp) is the authority and also checks that every link lands on a node.

id.description: What levels refer to (a "dialogue" action's id).

next.description: A node id or "end"; used when there are no choices.

sets.description: Flag set when this node is shown.

requires.description: Shown only if this flag is set.

requiresNot.description: Hidden if this flag is set.
